# The Sector You currently reside in sector J7, one of the first points of contact between the Monachopsis and Omicron galaxies. For reasons unknown Omicron began to accelerate at immeasurable speeds to the point of direct collision, but has now slowed to a crawl. Central Command took the opportunity to start operations in understanding how this happened, and what resides throughout the Omicron galaxy. As of now the data that has been observed has changed our understanding of the universe itself, as species found in our galaxy have been found inhabiting the Omicron Galaxy.
Current carbon dating from fossils indicate that the galaxy predates our own. The new species that reside here have also shown to predate most species found throughout Monachopsis. While the threat of continual galactic collisions has been stopped, the concerns it will resume again causing galactic destruction is leading researchers from both galaxies to work on understanding why this happened and how to stop it from continuing.
